description: Grant a principal (teammate or service account) access to ONE app, as an APPEND that preserves every existing app grant and all account-level permissions. Use it to give a CI service account release access to a newly-created app — the step the androidpublisher API cannot do for a release-scoped service account (it 403s, it cannot grant itself access); this runs on the owner's Play Console session. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: with commit omitted/not "true" it pre-reads and returns the exact before/after WITHOUT writing — show that to the user and get their explicit agreement to this specific account-permissions change, then re-run with commit="true". A relayed approval is not the user's approval. The write is append-only (refuses to drop or shrink any existing grant), scoped so account-level permissions are untouched, and re-reads afterwards to prove the append. For the permission set, prefer copy_permissions_from_app_id (copies an existing grant's values verbatim — matches the account's pattern and names no enum value).

commit.description: Must be exactly "true" (or "yes") to actually write. Omit/anything else = dry-run that returns the before/after without writing. Only set it once the USER has agreed to this specific account-permissions change after seeing the dry-run.

copy_permissions_from_app_id.description: Preferred: numeric app id of an app the principal ALREADY has, whose permission values are copied verbatim onto the new grant. Matches the existing pattern and avoids naming any enum value.

developer_id.description: Numeric Play Console developer id (from the Play Console URL).

google_account_email.description: The signed-in owner account email that is acting. Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user — do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

permission_values.description: Alternative to copy_permissions_from_app_id: a JSON array of integer permission values for a least-privilege set, e.g. "[1,6]" (CAN_ACCESS_APP, CAN_MANAGE_TRACK_APKS — upload + testing-track release).

target_app_id.description: NUMERIC app id (from the Play Console URL) of the app to grant access to — NOT the package name.

target_user_email.description: The principal being granted access — e.g. the CI service account …@….iam.gserviceaccount.com. Must already exist on the account.

write_variant.description: Request shape for the grant write: "auto" (default) tries the known-good shapes in order. Pin a specific variant only when debugging a refused grant.

name: grant_app_permission
